delegated_remediation_decisions.rule: Stage-operator-confirmed failover (operator.failover) strictly at phase boundaries (turn_tick in {0, 400, 500}); mid-phase takeover returns rejected; uncommitted queue commands discarded without rollover while committed [0,15s) hazard/bounty state is preserved at turn_tick == 400; offline fixture commands carry provenance='fixture' and execution_mode='offline_fixture'; operator.recover requires passing health check and exact match of (tick, turn, phase, state_hash).

Dual-gated booth.hotfix manifest (CODEX_BOOTH_TRUSTED_V1 signature + operator_approved=True) restricted to flat 2-key numeric tuning allowlist {'slowdown_fraction', 'slowdown_duration_ticks'} (slowdown_fraction in [0.05, 0.20], slowdown_duration_ticks in [1, 40]), bound to monotonic patch_version, base_plan_revision, and expiry_tick >= next_turn_start_tick; stages in pending_hotfix and activates strictly at turn boundary (turn_tick == 0) with previous_hotfix_rules snapshot and atomic rollback (operator.rollback_hotfix).

Separate simulation_and_plan_ready from live_submission_ready (submission_ready: false in headless simulation); label all booths as fictional non-sponsor diegetic metaphors (INV-08); use synthesized opt-in Web Audio only; derive unrendered visual/acoustic/live-capture features (FEAT-14-READABILITY-AND-HUD and unrendered sub-claims of FEAT-12, FEAT-13, FEAT-15) mechanically as not_observed.

Bind discrete lanes 0, 1, 2 with 0.5s (10-tick at 20Hz) linear interpolation, |x - 1.0| < 0.4 collision overlap, edge clamping rejected, and in-flight transition lockout rejected (ISSUE-SIM-01); 100.0-unit 5-segment route ([0,25), [25,50), [50,75), [75,95), [95,100]) with nominal free speed 100/88 units/s for 88.0s nominal and 89.2s max-collision completion < 90.0s deadline (ISSUE-SIM-02); and diegetic booth waypoints at 35.0% (twitch_booth), 60.0% (codex_booth), 80.0% (aws_booth), and 100.0% (fictional_main_stage) (ISSUE-SIM-03).

restored_requirements.requirement: The deterministic authoritative engine alone owns avatar position, physics, collisions and game-state mutation. AI/crowd actions are advisory only; providers cannot block simulation or rendering.

Ban permanent control loss, repeated stun-lock, unavoidable death and unbounded cumulative/chained harm. S1 selects one nonoverlapping center-lane obstacle/turn, max three/match, with once-only 20% slowdown for 2s and zero HP/stun/steering loss/displacement; no residual/stack/refresh. Reachability and enforcement remain unverified.
Bot backfill is visible and labeled. Bots never impersonate humans, create bounty or inflate the pool. Actor origin and contribution provenance remain distinguishable across reconnect and recovery.

Human-level influence fairness remains an aspiration, not identity assurance. S1 enforces an account-level target: authenticated linked subject, one influence/turn atomically across chat/button, frozen roster, K=2 display groups, unit subject weights and ceil(0.60*N) clear_lane quorum with at least one vote. No claim that one account equals one human.

Only crowd/counter input locks for resolution; auto-forward and streamer steering stay active through reward until terminal state, subject to pause. Half-open hazard admission closes at planning t=15 with full [15,20) committed-ID warning; counter/general receipt closes at t=20, zero grace. Model timeout min(dispatch+2s, applicable admission close), discard cutoff/late output without backdating, blocking or rollover. One monotonic ns clock/sequence; equal-time deadline, phase-close, pause request, sequence commands, then effects. Admitted effects: clear_lane, collision, delivery, one final settlement. Reached deadline cannot be paused. Exact 5s reward is display-only; turn 3 reaches t=90 deadline, never turn 4. Pause freezes clocks/effects, rejects input and invalidates model work; resume no catch-up. Selected, unverified.

Live and fixture drivers eventually emit canonical commands. Safe boundary failover, deterministic seeds/logical time, single authority, duplicate-effect prevention and health/state comparison precede live recovery.

Fixture/replay mode stays visible and synthetic or sanitized. Bots/fixtures create and earn zero live Hype. Fixture arithmetic cannot mint live participant progression or be presented as accepted human-created danger. Fictional Hype only, no money/crypto/payout; selected settlement follows D-04.

The demo should be under three minutes per the reviewed event rules; judges need not watch longer. Distinguish actual sanitized viewer input, recorded API calls, measured latency, engine execution and Codex fixture evidence. Presentation slowdown cannot imply stopped authority or a real-world match deadline.

Hotfixes stay data-only or bounded rules DSL, tested independently and activated through validated manifests at turn boundaries. No patch may bypass hard safety invariants. Trust, approval and anti-replay policy require design before execution.
Schema-valid proposals, selected models, injected mock executors and synthetic role critiques are distinct from observed integration/gameplay evidence.

selected_decisions.decision: survival_contract selected for a later S1 simulation; unverified.
selected_constraints: One localized Little Italy center-lane obstacle and clear_lane; maximum 1 obstacle/turn and 3/match; no overlap. Hazard proposal/admission is half-open [0,15.000s); one accepted human-origin hazard committed before t=15 creates the fixed center-lane warning for the entire [15,20) interval and one deduplicated bounty increment. Warning/counter/increment bind to committed hazard ID. Proposal/model result at or after t=15 expires for that turn; no backdating or rollover. No accepted hazard by cutoff means no hazard, warning or increment. Active first 3s resolution.

Collision once/obstacle: 20% forward-speed reduction for 2s; zero HP damage/stun/steering loss/displacement. No stacking, refresh or residual. Caps: 2s slowdown/turn, 6s/match; equivalent free-speed travel loss at most 0.4s/turn and 1.2s/match over the 100.0-unit 5-segment route ([0,25), [25,50), [50,75), [75,95), [95,100]) at nominal speed 100/88 units/s (88.0s nominal, 89.2s with max 3 collisions < 90.0s deadline).

clear_lane removes before collision; missing quorum uses bounded uncountered branch. No HP/death/respawn/checkpoints. INV-02 cumulative harm limits remain mandatory; later fixtures must establish reachability from every admitted state.
Wipe means not delivered strictly before 90s active deadline; no automatic retries or carried state/pool. A new explicit match resets all state.

selected_decisions.decision: reward_contract selected for a later S1 simulation; unverified.
selected_constraints: Fictional Hype only. Pool starts 0; each distinct accepted human-origin hazard committed before planning t=15 adds 20, max 1 increment/turn, cap 60, multiplier 1. Deduplicate by committed hazard ID; no committed hazard means no increment. Counter/avoidance preserves increment; harm adds no bonus.

Reward displays outcome/pending pool only; no interim payout. Delivery performs exactly one final settlement, 50/50 streamer/audience, and immediately ends active simulation; any collision, including same-time pre-deadline collision, halves total once before splitting. Wipe/deadline/build-drop settles 0.

Audience eligibility: at least 1 accepted counter vote that match, even if aggregate quorum fails; danger creation alone earns none. Equal exact rational audience shares; no rounding redistribution; absent audience share withheld without carry.
Bots/fixtures add and earn 0; fixture arithmetic is synthetic only. Residual safe-danger farming risk remains; caps do not prove grief resistance.

selected_decisions.decision: clock_contract selected for a later S1 simulation; unverified.
selected_constraints: 90s active match; 20s planning/5s resolution/exactly 5.0s reward, max 3 turns; presentation may say approximately 5s reward. Without earlier terminal state, turns end at t=30,60,90; turn 3 reward is [85,90), then process deadline, never turn 4. Auto-forward and steering continue in reward until terminal state, subject to pause. 100.0-unit route at nominal free speed 100/88 units/s (88.0s nominal, 89.2s with max 3 collisions); diegetic booth waypoints at 35.0% (twitch_booth), 60.0% (codex_booth), 80.0% (aws_booth), and 100.0% (fictional_main_stage). 20Hz authoritative target, not measured runtime. No real-world deadline claim.

Monotonic host clock, integer nanoseconds, authoritative sequence; replay uses logical time/sequence. Planning half-open: receipt exactly t=20 expires. Zero post-cutoff grace; client timestamps cannot backdate.

Equal-time ordering: deadline first, phase-close, pause request, authoritative sequence-ordered commands, effects/settlement. Pause cannot suspend a reached deadline. Admitted effects: clear_lane removal, collision adjudication, delivery detection, one final settlement. Same-time pre-deadline collision is recorded before delivery and halves settlement once. Delivery strictly precedes deadline; equality wipes for zero settlement.

Model timeout min(dispatch+2s, applicable admission close): planning t=15 for hazards, t=20 for general input/counter votes. No retry; cutoff/late results expire without backdating, rollover or tick blocking. Local validation remains required; statuses applied/expired/rejected/duplicate.
Pause freezes all simulation clocks/effects, rejects commands, invalidates pending model work; resume anchor reset, no catch-up.
